app.name: Gekko2 SPEED BETA12.31a CPU STATUS
app.long_description: GS byte/half/word acknowledgements and pending IMR interrupts, Q/K/L mipmaps and MTBA, bounded VIF CPU FIFO, writable SPU2 ENVX and precise GX filter fallbacks. Includes previous core changes. Chain, PSM and GX risk remain factory OFF and apply at Cold Boot. No verified Wii gameplay, BIOS-tile fix or FPS gain. Bring your own legal BIOS/disc/card.
